5. Per-shape gate (runs once, in warmup, outside capture): time 5 iterations of `_forward_impl_nchw` vs the existing NHWC `_forward_impl` with cudaEvents; keep the faster one for that shape key. This preserves round-3's conv-plan re-selection (it still runs for the NHWC path) rather than replacing it, and guarantees no per-shape regression on the 4 scored shapes.
6. Numeric self-check: keep the existing one-time `torch.allclose(out, F.conv2d(x,w,None,1,1), atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)` on the Winograd output; on mismatch or any cuDNN NOT_SUPPORTED, set `use_winograd=false` permanently and fall back. FP32 Winograd is strictly more accurate than the TF32 reference, so tolerance is safe; no dtype change anywhere.
7. Preserve existing mechanisms: cuda-graph capture unchanged (winograd workspaces are per-(slot,shape) tensors allocated in warmup, never inside capture); 2-stream batch split unchanged (each slot keeps its own out buffer + workspace, so no cross-stream aliasing); cudnn.benchmark and the v7 NHWC plan cache stay in place for the fallback path.
8. Guard workspace growth: if `ws_w` for the largest shape (4x256x256x256) exceeds the cap, the gate simply keeps NHWC for that shape; batch split already halves N, halving Winograd workspace.
strategy.evidence: Conv kernels = 88.5% of forward GPU time (34.9+10.1+8.8+6.9+6.8+5.7+5.3+5.3+4.7); all five custom kernels together = 5.0% (308+231+208+107 us). Mid shape: 1.55e11 FLOP of conv in ~1.70 ms = 91 TFLOPS = 87% of the 104.8 TFLOPS TF32 peak -> root cause is raw multiply count, not memory or stalls, so only an algorithmic FLOP reduction (Winograd, 2.25x fewer multiplies) moves the needle. Refutation of the alternative 'DRAM-bound epilogue': gn_apply_silu_add_t indeed shows 89.1% DRAM throughput and 96% long-scoreboard stalls, but it is 1.8% of forward time, so perfecting it caps the round at <2%; its transpose is nonetheless removed for free by the NCHW switch.
strategy.expected_metric_change: Conv segment GPU time down >=25% (cutlass/xmma s1688fprop TF32 kernels replaced by winograd fp32 kernels in nsys); total forward launches drop (to_nhwc_kernel and gn_apply_silu_add_t_kernel launch counts go to 0 on the winograd path; convertTensor_kernel's 1001 us / 64 launches should not increase). sm__throughput on the conv rises while executed FLOPs fall; DRAM throughput of the GN kernels stays ~85-89% (they are unchanged in traffic). Anti-regression constraints: (a) per-shape warmup gate must keep the NHWC implicit-GEMM path whenever timed Winograd is slower, so none of the 4 scored shapes may regress; (b) cuda-graph replay must still be used (graph count per key unchanged, no allocation inside capture) and the 2-stream overlap must still be visible in the timeline - if either disappears, the mechanism is mis-implemented; (c) Winograd workspace must never exceed 25% of free VRAM.
